text: Consider the following expressions: (i) false (ii) Q (iii) true (iv) P∨Q (v) ¬Q∨P. The number of expressions given above that are logically implied by P ∧ (P ⇒ Q) is ______.
solution: P∧(P⇒Q) ≡ P∧(¬P∨Q) ≡ P∧Q, which is true only in the row P=T, Q=T. In that row Q, true, P∨Q and ¬Q∨P are all true, while false is not. So 4 of the 5 expressions are logically implied.
